dynamic_line: &The intercom hisses.  A voice of indeterminate sex speaks flatly.  "I don't know who you are or how you got to this location, but we have nothing to gain from one another.  If you have a reason to be here, then please state your business.  Otherwise, please leave the area."

responses.text: I have a delivery from the Free Merchants.  You requested a hard drive from them.
You do realize that the front door is just open?
It's the apocalypse out here!  Please just let me in!
I'm just looking for valuables.  Maybe we can trade?
Look, there must be something we can work out.
Well truth be told, this encounter ain't quite so random.

dynamic_line.//~: 'Saluton' and 'Ĉu vi povas kompreni min?' are Esperanto, and should stay Esperanto, unless being this line is being translated into Esperanto, of course.
dynamic_line.str: &The intercom hisses.  You hear a series of beeps, then a THUNK as if someone were touching a microphone.  Muffled voices argue in the background.  A brief moment of clarity allows you to hear "-o that didn't work."  After a moment, a voice of indeterminate sex speaks flatly.  "Saluton.  Greetings.  Ĉu vi povas kompreni min?  Or do you speak English, by chance?"
